judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test-setup phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the bug. Because the production `error instanceof Error` gate remains untouched, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately on the first non-Error rejection. The candidate also missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch artifact in the diff. On the positive side, the candidate updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and wrote a sound acceptance test covering the string, plain object, `undefined`, and `Error` cases.
